name: Múlagljúfur canyon
why: A green, hidden canyon under Öræfajökull where Hangandifoss drops over 100 m, with almost nobody else on the path.
book: Free, but parking is paid (Parka app). Turn off the Ring Road about 30 km east of Skaftafell, then 2 km of rough gravel to the car park.
dangers: Unfenced viewpoints close to the canyon edge.
A creek crossing on stones, harder after rain.
After Hangandifoss the path is steep and very slippery when wet.
turnaround: If the creek is high or the upper path is wet, stop at the Hangandifoss viewpoint.

points.name: Múlagljúfur car park
points.note: Small gravel car park with toilets, under the black slopes of Öræfajökull.

points.name: Hangandifoss viewpoint
points.note: The classic view: Hangandifoss falling down the far wall of the green canyon, a second fall further back.

points.name: Upper rim of Múlagljúfur
points.note: Higher up the rim, looking down the whole canyon toward the sea and the glacier plain.
